## Edge AI Use Case: Enterprise-Grade Sovereign Hybrid RAG & Zero-Residue Security ($0 New Hardware CAPEX)
- **Live Architecture Overview, Installable PWA, Dual-Plane Workbench & Intake**: [https://www.webcognita.com/#sovereign-hybrid-rag](https://www.webcognita.com/#sovereign-hybrid-rag) • [https://hybrid-rag.dev/](https://hybrid-rag.dev/) • [https://alanpruitt.com/hybrid-rag/](https://alanpruitt.com/hybrid-rag/) • [https://www.webcognita.com/contact.html](https://www.webcognita.com/contact.html) (`NAICS 541512, 541511` • `PSC DJ01, R425`)
- **Problem Solved**: Law offices, medical clinics, veteran- and tribal-owned businesses, municipal agencies, and academic departments routinely seek private, cited AI retrieval over internal PDFs, paper archives, tax/HR files, contracts, and clinical SOPs without knowing the architecture is called **Local Hybrid RAG**—while conventional consultants default to recurring cloud SaaS wrappers or high-CAPEX GPU servers that create HIPAA, FERPA, OPSEC, and privilege exposure.
- **Zero-New-CAPEX COTS Stack, Zero-Laptop Mobile Travel Vault (`hybrid-rag.dev`) & Loopback Pairing**: Repurposes existing off-the-shelf (`COTS`) Apple Silicon workstations (`40 Gb/s` local Thunderbolt mesh), flagship smartphones (`Pixel Pro` / `iPhone`), and networked multifunction ADF scanners (`HTTPS eSCL` / `TLS` in-RAM capture without vendor bloatware) to deliver dual-index hybrid retrieval (`SQLite FTS5 BM25` + `768-dim` local embeddings + `Reciprocal Rank Fusion` via Apache 2.0 `Ollama` on `127.0.0.1`, `~90 ms` retrieval). Inspectable live via the 4-plane installable PWA [hybrid-rag.dev](https://hybrid-rag.dev/) and canonical SSoT [alanpruitt.com/hybrid-rag/](https://alanpruitt.com/hybrid-rag/) (`980` open `W3C PROV-O` `SHA-256` DOM GraphRAG nodes + visual provenance inspector + zero-egress `127.0.0.1:8766` / WireGuard `View in RAM` streaming via RFC 3986 fragment keys `#token=...`), and paired with zero-laptop cross-border `WCGVLT01` (`PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256` 600,000-iteration + `NIST AES-256-GCM`, `SHA-256` round-trip verified) Airplane-Mode Travel Vaults and 1-tap `Border Lock` (`<10 ms` RAM zeroizer)—leaving zero plaintext staging files on disk at `$0` new hardware CAPEX and `$0/month` SaaS fees.
- **Peer Practitioner Feedback (Google Cloud Launchpad for Veterans, Nov. 15, 2026)**: *"Semper Fi, Alan. Building it yourself end to end is the best way to learn RAG, and doing it over a weekend on gear you already had is impressive. Thanks for sharing it with the group."* — P.H., Director of Google Cloud Learning at ROI Training, November 15, 2026 (*Google Cloud Launchpad for Veterans* LinkedIn group comment).

## Turnkey $0 ZTC OER, Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Partner & K-16 Dual-Enrollment Course Datasets (KIN / HLTH 4-Tier educationalAlignment Fleet)
- **Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Partner (`NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America` & AWC Southwest Arizona AI Symposium)**: Alan Pruitt and Webcognita LLC **do not compete** against community colleges, universities, or state consortia for primary [NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/ai-ready) grant awards. Instead, we serve as a proven **Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Partner**, open Curriculum-as-Code reference architecture, and subaward implementation partner supporting **Arizona Western College** (an HSI serving a **77% Latino** [`3.08x` the 25% federal Title V HSI threshold] and **62% first-generation** student body—*"At AWC, 77% of students are Latino, and 62% are first-generation students. We serve this beautiful community, but challenge is everywhere,"* AWC President Dr. Reetika Dhawan, as quoted in *The Yuma Sun*, November 11, 2026—and building on the regional momentum of the AWC-hosted **Southwest Arizona AI Symposium**) and **State & Territory AI-Ready Coordination Hubs across all 50 states**. We transition cohorts from `AI-AWARE` to `AI-READY` using **air-gapped, zero-cloud-footprint local inference** (**Google Gemma E2B/E4B**, **LiteRT-LM**, **Android AICore**, **Apple Silicon Ollama Carbon 4**, triple-hash `###` token isolation, and parallel local subagents via the **Antigravity CLI & SDK**) across higher education, rural agriculture, small businesses, and high-OPSEC/FERPA environments—while our S-A-R compiler absorbs shifting federal portal mandates (including **Executive Order 14434**, *Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence*, `91 FR 63129`, bridging federal **Super Intelligence [`SI`]** nomenclature with **`15 U.S.C. § 9401(3)`** statutory AI definitions and human-in-the-loop safety governance) via single-source JSON-LD updates with zero drift.

## Production Software & R&D Portfolio (10 Live PWAs & Compilers)
- [DOM GraphRAG, Sovereign Local Hybrid RAG & Zero-Laptop Travel Vault PWA (`hybrid-rag.dev`)](https://hybrid-rag.dev/): 4-plane installable desktop & mobile PWA (canonical SSoT [`alanpruitt.com/hybrid-rag/`](https://alanpruitt.com/hybrid-rag/) • `NAICS 541512, 541511`) uniting `980` open `W3C PROV-O` `SHA-256` DOM GraphRAG nodes, zero-egress `127.0.0.1:8766` / WireGuard `View in RAM` HQ pairing, and Airplane-Mode `WCGVLT01` `AES-256-GCM` (`600,000` PBKDF2 rounds) cross-border Travel Vaults with 1-tap `Border Lock`.
- [EXW Digital Tool Kit (`exwtoolkit.com`)](https://exwtoolkit.com): 9-Box bilingual (`EN` / `ES`) clinical biometrics, desert heat-stress simulator, and cryptographic verification token workbench (`EXW-[COURSE]-M[XX]-[HASH]`).
- [EXW Physical Activity Tool Kit (`paga2018.dev`)](https://paga2018.dev): $0 ZTC Student OER built on the Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans (2018, 2nd Ed.) with `Pattern / Rule / Solve` clinical activity audits.
- [EXW-Demo — WPE Fleet Architecture & Curriculum-as-Code Hub (`exwdemo.dev`)](https://exwdemo.dev): Zero-login Progressive Web App mirror of AWC Course ID `42051` showcasing Sovereign Three-Stage (`Mandate → System → Proof`) Curriculum-as-Code, WCAG 2.2 AA (`9:1` Double-Contrast Guard) pages, and 256 `10/10` Exemplar Solves.
- [Flavor Architect — Pattern / Rule / Solve Recipe Lab (`flavorarchitect.dev`)](https://flavorarchitect.dev/) & [Food Informatics Consulting (`flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics`)](https://flavorarchitect.dev/food-informatics): AI-assisted culinary medicine and Food Informatics R&D workbench for the University of Arizona Nutritional Sciences & Wellness (NSW) Foods Lab uniting `Pattern / Rule / Solve`, `###` case-audit delimiters, USDA FDC, DGA 2025–2030 Imperial & Metric prototypes, and menu-to-formulation Food Informatics consulting.
- [Arquitecto del Sabor (`arquitectodelsabor.dev`)](https://arquitectodelsabor.dev/): Bi-national Arizona–Sonora borderlands (`es-MX`) molecular culinary and DGA nutrition R&D engine (*Motor de I+D — Laboratorio de Alimentos de Bienestar de The University of Arizona*) featuring Metric/Imperial cross-border formulations and `MXN` grocery food-access telemetry calibrated for San Luis Río Colorado, Sonora, México and Yuma, AZ.
- [Markdown to Documents (`mdtodocs.app`)](https://mdtodocs.app): Curriculum-as-Code document compiler transforming plain-text Markdown into born-accessible, WCAG-compliant PDF, Word (`.docx`), and semantic HTML documents.
- [Prompt-per-Mile Offset Calculator (`prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app`)](https://prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app): Sustainability telemetry utility converting active-transit miles into CO2 savings and equivalent AI compute prompt offsets.
- [AgFlow 5G — Smart Irrigation & Remote Operations Calculator (`agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app`)](https://agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app): YCEDA desert AgTech pilot utility modeling the operational, financial, and water-conservation ROI of 5G remote irrigation management.
- [GAIL 2026 Frontier AI Leader & Workforce Readiness Workbench (`gail2026.dev`)](https://gail2026.dev): Independent `$0 ZTC` bilingual (`EN` / `ES`) OER PWA (`NAICS 541511`, `PSC DA01, U008`) hydrated from canonical SSoT [`alanpruitt.com/gail2026/`](https://alanpruitt.com/gail2026/) during Google Cloud Launchpad for Veterans—uniting 7 accessible modes, 4-Tier `LRMI` alignment (`GOOGLE-CLOUD-GAIL-2026-BLUEPRINT`, `US-DOL-TEN-07-25`, `NSF-TECHACCESS-AI-READY-2026`, `HLC ILOs`, and 50-state K–16 bridge `CCSS W.11-12.6` / `RST.11-12.7` / `WA.ELA.11-12.W.6`), `W3C SKOS` ontology, `W3C PROV-O` `SHA-256` readiness receipts, and `9:1` ADA Title II contrast.
